Which Parent Gave It

STS-HS10-L4-10001300-HSSCILIFE-LEC-AAD-01 • HS Life Science Grade 10 • DNA and Chromosomes in Inherited Traits
Look at the picture. You will answer some questions about it. Press the play button to hear each question. Record your answer for each question. You can listen to your answer and record it again. Click SUBMIT RECORDINGS when you have answered all the questions.
JUST FOR FUN · OPTIONAL
A Lab Experiment Challenge asks one question the plants have to answer for you. Imani's group is running theirs on a cowpea line that came out of the Freedom Seed Library, where okra, sorghum, benne and rice have been saved by hand for generations. Every seed keeper who chose the best plant and saved from it was already running this experiment, one season at a time. This year the offspring pod came out dark red like Parent A, and the group has to say why.
The offspring pod is dark red like Parent A. What would you need to see in the next generation to know Parent B still passed down instructions for pod color?
Optional. You do not have to record this one.
1
What is Imani doing?
Look at the picture. Explain Imani's action, her purpose, and the evidence in the picture that supports your claim. Use the phrase I know because.
2
What is Tobi holding?
Look at the picture. Explain what Tobi is holding and the part it plays in the group's investigation, with evidence.
3
What is the teacher doing?
Look at the picture. Explain the teacher's action and how her result supports the group's claim, with evidence.
4
What room is this? How do you know?
Look at the picture. Explain what room this is and defend your answer with two separate pieces of evidence.
5
Tell me about the board. What do you see on it?
Look at the picture. Explain what the board is comparing and what conclusion the three panels support.
6
What is Naima wearing?
Look at the picture. Explain what Naima has on and what it suggests about the work she is doing, with evidence.
Record an answer for each question, then submit.
